run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the first non-repeating element in an array of integers
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify non-repeating element detection
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash map instead of brute force for better performance
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that finds the first unique element in an array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the first non-repeating element or negative one if none exists
